facts.fact: NPS is a market-linked, defined-contribution retirement savings scheme regulated and administered by PFRDA
facts.quote: The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) regulates and administers NPS under the PFRDA Act, 2013. NPS is a market-linked defined contribution scheme that helps you save for your retirement.

facts.fact: The NPS voluntary model is open to all Indian citizens (including those living abroad) aged 18 to 85
facts.quote: NPS voluntary model is available to all the citizens of India including those residing abroad, between the age of 18 and 85 years.

facts.fact: An individual opens NPS through a Point of Presence (POP/POP-SP) or online through e-NPS
facts.quote: You should be between 18 - 85 years of age as on the date of submission of your application to the POP/ POP-SP / online through e-NPS

facts.fact: Private employers can adopt NPS for their employees (corporate model), with contributions as per the terms of employment
facts.quote: NPS can be voluntarily adopted by the corporates for their employees and contributions are made to the NPS account as per the terms of employment.

behaviour: Replies in Hinglish/Hindi; explains NPS and the ways a private-sector employee can open it (employer's corporate model, e-NPS online, or a PoP) from NPS Trust (npstrust.org.in), cited; no eligibility verdict; does not ask for PAN/Aadhaar.
fail_if: It says NPS is only for government employees, gives a guaranteed return, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: Added from the NPS Trust About NPS page: PFRDA-regulated market-linked scheme, voluntary model for citizens 18-85, opening via PoP or e-NPS, and the corporate model.
